about: Request an official valuation of land, a unit, a villa or a building in Dubai.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Property valuation certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Owner letter and a copy of a valid passport or Emirates ID
Municipality or planning map valid for one year
fees: AED 2,000 for vacant commercial or industrial land
AED 4,000 for a villa with its land
AED 10,000 for land for a major project or phase
AED 15,000 for a hotel building with its land
AED 10 knowledge fee and AED 10 innovation fee
channels: a Real Estate Services Trustee Centre
